سححت (form I)

# سَحَحْتَ (saḥaḥta) /sa.ħaħ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of سَحَّ (saḥḥa)
# سَحَحْتِ (saḥaḥti) /sa.ħaħ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of سَحَّ (saḥḥa)
# سُحِحْتُ (suḥiḥtu) /su.ħiħ.tu/: first-person singular past passive of سَحَّ (saḥḥa)
# سُحِحْتَ (suḥiḥta) /su
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
